items.notes: Contrasts refresh with eviction and notes refresh is not initiated until a read; does not state when expiration alone breaks freshness.
Describes EDS endpoint membership and per-host attributes, but says nothing about health probing or stale discovery data.
Explains relay leasing and at-least-once publication; gives no poison-row handling or operator plan.
Explains that only reusable responses benefit, cacheability is an authorization contract, and private personalized content cannot safely use shared caching.
Defines parallel run and its side-effect constraints; does not name a lower-overhead comparison alternative.
About index families and planner choice, not range/hash partitioning or exposure of writes and range queries.
Quorum arithmetic shows added voters raise required votes without raising failure tolerance; the write-capacity implication is not stated.
Defines recall@k over independently judged relevant items; does not address incomplete judgments or their effect.
Shows overload dominated by timeouts with negligible rejection; does not address a service that rejects most requests.
Lists runtime-parity and generated-change failure modes; no repository-structure baseline or writer inventory is discussed.
Describes dual-write reconciliation and hidden backlog; gives no quantities governing backlog growth or drainage.
Describes Netflix gateway scaling pressure, not a cloud-migration failure that motivated rebuilding an application.
Route table points to the identity/ADRs page that asks this coherence question but supplies no answer itself.
Storage-model reading route; does not discuss embedding related records or lifecycle fit.
Separates the runtime/deployment axis from the data-ownership/state-authority axis and warns a process is not a domain boundary.
Defines safe/idempotent semantics versus business-effect deduplication; no dedup-key expiry or post-expiry test is covered.
Explains carrier starvation from pinned waiters; does not mention database permits or a separate admission problem.
Requires explicit edge semantics and direction, warns a path proves neither causality nor permission, and bounds traversal.
Mentions bounded variable-length traversal and explosion/pruning concerns; does not specify depth or visited-set bounds.
States that averages conceal hot-key pressure and equal-sized populations can differ in bursts; supports the uniform-key test critique.
Contrasts trace correlation in operational logs with principal/action/immutable event identity and ordering in audit records.
Run-record table includes convergence, hashes and limits; no rationale for why the result hash includes them.
States that events scheduled at the same time depend on hash order, which is the queue's tie-break and a listed failure mode.
Reports uncertainty and convergence and disclaims production proof; does not discuss replication count versus input-distribution uncertainty.
Lists hard, soft and non-quantitative constraints and possible outcomes; does not state how a failed hard constraint is treated.
